## Overview

This Adapter Validation Suite (AVS) instantiates the [UIAO_121 Adapter Conformance Test Plan](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/blob/main/src/uiao/canon/specs/adapter-conformance-test-plan-template.md) for the `dhs-everify-attribute-service` adapter. It defines the Tier-1 contract-conformance criteria, the controls under validation, and the integration test plan that govern the adapter across its lifecycle.

## Validation status

**Reserved slot — not yet implemented.** `dhs-everify-attribute-service` is `status: reserved` / `phase: phase-planning` in canon. No adapter code exists yet. The Tier-1 criteria below define the conformance gate the adapter **must** clear at activation; they are a forward-looking plan, not a current result.

## Scope

Target surfaces / subsystems: `employment-authorization`, `i9-verification`

**Validation artifacts:** `everify-attribute-response.json`, `everify-disclosure-audit.json`

The suite validates that, for each target surface, the adapter normalizes vendor data into canonical claims, emits deterministic provenance, and produces KSI-anchored evidence — without mutating any source system (`ssot-mutation: never`).

## Controls under validation

The control roles below are mirrored from the adapter's companion [Adapter Technical Specification](../../../adapter-specs/dhs-everify-attribute-service/dhs-everify-attribute-service.html); the validation suite verifies that the adapter produces the evidence each role asserts.

NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls this adapter supports: `IA-2`, `IA-4`, `AU-2`, `AU-12`, `SC-8`, `SC-13`

| Control | Role | Adapter capability |
|---|---|---|
| **IA-2** Identification and Authentication | Supporting | Employment-authorization claims supplement identification by establishing the work-eligibility attribute. |
| **IA-4** Identifier Management | Primary | E-Verify case id is the stable identifier for each authorization disclosure. |
| **AU-2** Event Logging | Primary | Every disclosure is logged with the canonical disclosure-audit envelope and entitlement reference. |
| **AU-12** Audit Record Generation | Supporting | Audit records carry the canonical provenance envelope per ADR-006. |
| **SC-8** Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity | Primary | All E-Verify exchanges are TLS-protected. |
| **SC-13** Cryptographic Protection | Supporting | Validation uses FIPS-validated cryptographic libraries. |

## Notes from canon

E-Verify is a composite authority of record (DHS USCIS + SSA) for employment authorization verification under IIRIRA §403. This adapter observes employment-authorization disclosures — both employer-initiated (Form I-9) and federal-agency-initiated (FAR 52.222-54). Activation requires a per-adapter ADR modeled on ADR-035.
